input_contract: AUTOPILOT_SAVE selects the original user-owned native SAVE; originals are read-only. Newer Trade and Hunt snapshots remain with their private SAVE data owner, outside Git.
execution: Run AUTOPILOT_PROBE=<mode> AUTOPILOT_SAVE=<original> through codex-run-scratch run --max-bytes 2147483648 --max-files 20000 --seconds 180 --reserve-bytes 10737418240 -- <prepared Python> docs/evidence/autopilot-20261030/save-policy-replay.py
conditions: Actual native VM LoadState and canonical PROGRAM projection. OnLoad suppressed. Entity presence, locator/task dispatch and native encounter catalog are seams. Full-hold quantities mutate a disposable derived snapshot only. No game launch, UI, original SAVE mutation, installation or shared build.

performance: Times cover complete VM Run invocation, including resumed script/startup work and multiple callbacks; they are not frame-time/FPS evidence. Pricing and market projection run at route transitions or the existing dated retry. Holds and sale quantities are read once per decision. Hunt reacquisition is O(native live encounter count); retained target uses one revalidated catalog selector. No added rendered-frame loop or changed callback cadence.
limits: This proves script policy and finite ledger behavior on the saved state with explicit native seams. Root-owned native lifecycle/delivery evidence remains necessary for installed activation, motion and actual gameplay. Unknown prior cargo acquisition costs cannot establish absolute profit. Canonical quest flags are respected; no new quest cargo inference system is introduced.
